text:
maya: heads-up — northamerica warm-pool failed to finish onboarding this morning after the firewall egress tighten rolled out. spot GPU nodes keep flapping, warmup stuck at ~40%. seeing lots of keystore decrypt errors and audit exporter 403s.

ali: ugh, saw the alert. are nodes failing to reach the keystore endpoint or is it an IAM deny?

neha: log snippet from one failed node: ```
2026-03-22T09:04:12Z WARN keystore: decrypt failed status=403 body=\"AccessDenied\" svc=keystore.region.prod 
2026-03-22T09:04:12Z ERROR join: token exchange failed: tls handshake: remote error: unknown_ca
```

jordan: looks like firewall is dropping traffic to our keystore privatelink IP range (10.200.5.0/24) after the new deny-by-default rule. ops ran a dry-run but the allowlist missed privatelink.

sre-oncall: +1 — I repro'd in staging. conntrack shows SYN->RST when node hits keystore IP. also audit exporter (shipper) gets 403 when trying to send to SIEM over HTTPS.

maya: consequence: autoscaler is falling back to on-demand pools and we burned ~$1.2k last 3h in fallback costs. customer latency SLOs degraded briefly.

ali: immediate fix proposal: temporarily relax egress to keystore privatelink CIDR and SIEM endpoints for the warm-pool subnets, then re-run node join. Will need an audit-safe short-lived exception (max 2h).

neha: Agreed. also saw a KMS policy change yesterday that tightened principals — might explain 403s from instances using ephemeral IAM role. tagging the change: `iam-team#1729`.

jordan: action list: 1) open egress to 10.200.5.0/24 and SIEM FQNs (siem.redwood-int, logs.partner) 443 for warm-pool subnets; 2) revert the specific firewall rule that blocked privatelink for warmpool tag; 3) confirm KMS key policy allows the new instance role (check `redwood-warmpool-role`); 4) shrink exception after join and run compliance review.

sre-oncall: I'll own 1+2 now. prepping terraform change: ```hcl
resource \"firewall_rule\" \"tmp-warmpool-keystore-allow\" {
  name     = \"tmp-warmpool-keystore-allow\"
  src_tags = [\"warmpool\"]
  dest_cidr_blocks = [\"10.200.5.0/24\"]
  ports = [443]
  ttl = 7200 # 2 hours
}
```

maya: please annotate the change with the compliance ticket #CMP-882 and add audit log webhook for the change. keep the TTL strict.

ali: neha — can you verify KMS key policy and add `Condition: StringEquals\n {\"aws:SourceAccount\": \"123456789012\"}` if missing? i want to make sure decrypts from ephemeral roles are allowed.

neha: on it — quick check shows the key policy still references the old role ARN. I'll add `redwood-warmpool-role` and reissue. will ping when done.

infra-bot: terraform plan complete for `tmp-warmpool-keystore-allow` — awaiting apply by `sre-oncall`.

sre-oncall: applied. nodes are reattempting join. watching logs.

(5m later)

jordan: join rate climbing — warmpool now at 92%. a few nodes still hitting legacy SIEM domain which we forgot to allow, adding `logs-legacy.partner:443`.

neha: KMS key policy updated and successful decrypts observed. sample log: ```
2026-03-22T09:17:33Z INFO keystore: decrypt ok key_id=alias/redwood-warmpool caller=redwood-warmpool-role
```

maya: great. keep the firewall exception running for 1h for extra signal, then remove and re-validate. schedule a postmortem with security to review the rollout checklist gaps.

ali: cost note: estimate fallback on-demand cost burned ~$1200 (last 3h). tagging finance and product leads.

ops-bot: incident #INC-2026-092 created (severity: low) — warm-pool onboarding interruption; runbook link: https://infra.runbooks/redwood/warmpool-egress.

(1h later)

sre-oncall: removing temporary firewall allow rule now. apply done.

jordan: nodes stable after rollback. warm-pool at 99%.

neha: filing a change to the KMS policy deployment pipeline to ensure role ARNs are updated during role rotations. ticket: INFRA-451.

maya: postmortem tomorrow 10:30am — include security, infra, and devex. thanks team :thumbsup:

ops-bot: incident #INC-2026-092 resolved. duration 2h7m.

maya: closing thread — follow-ups: INFRA-451, CMP-882, add keystore privatelink CIDR to firewall-test-suite, and add a smoke check for keystore decrypt during firewall rollouts.
